examples.prompt: Make a ranked bar chart of cycling's share of commutes in six made-up cities, with the percentage labelled on each bar.
examples.caption: Six fictional cities ranked by cycling's share of commutes · direct labels, zero baseline, hover for values

examples.prompt: Chart a year of monthly solar generation for three fictional regions against a monthly target, from a CSV. I want an overview strip I can drag across to zoom the main chart, and a legend I can click to focus on one region.
examples.caption: A year of solar generation for three regions against a target · drag the overview to zoom, click a region to focus

examples.prompt: Build a dashboard exploring made-up mobility data for 10 cities over 12 months: a scatterplot of average trip distance vs cycling share that I can brush, bars comparing the brushed cities with all cities by region, a monthly cycling trend for the selection, and a dropdown to filter by region.
examples.caption: A linked dashboard over 120 city-months · brush the scatterplot and the bars and trend follow, plus a region filter
